text: checker.rs exhaustiveness is one usefulness walk (CS3-1): a literal inside a payload covers only that value (`Some(0)`, `E::A { s: "x" }`, an untyped lambda subject), each such hole now E0304 at check where it panicked `no match arm matched` at run; `(Some(true), _)` + `(Some(false), _)` + `(None, _)` and its Result/enum/nested twins check clean again (CS2-4 regression). E1209 carries the refinement's line (CS3-3); `==`/`!=` on an Option/Result says the comparison is the problem, and the missing-variant fix-it is valid Axon (CS3-5). No evaluator change.
